review.description: S1-S5 keep release upgrade, rollback, private diagnostics and explicit operator configuration authority. No service, browser, runtime profile or installation operation changes.
review.implementation: Compared the provider/factory-only source diff with untouched setup/gateway code. The new durable record is application SQLite state and contains only revision/current-state/retry timing; failure reporting continues through the existing factory health path. Current-target AGENTS API-read requirements were reviewed: these changes execute in background GitHub reconciliation and use existing Store.Write invalidation; no request handler, projection construction, authorization or operation-receipt path changes. The current exact f1769f6 target raises the GitHub default allowance to2,000 attempts/hour while preserving explicit overrides and rolling-window admission, batches Make ownership exports, adds budget/ownership assertions and retains the60-minute hosted bound. Compared actual target changes and assertions: all target runtime/tooling/test bytes are preserved, maintain-flow-contracts catalog matches target exactly, all target sync-inbox implementation/test rows remain, and this PR adds only facet and fixture-assertion coverage. Existing75ms useful-success gates and production cancellation rules remain unchanged. The runtime diff remains limited to facet-related provider/factory code; the subsequent repair changes only transport fixture preparation and assertion metadata. No production75ms deadline is introduced. Integrated exact d485 structured configuration communication: actual messages/questions tests distinguish redacted deduplicated cards, suspended exact native replies, invalid/duplicate/expired answers, unchanged proposal authority, retained native tool catalogs and compact changed-setting diffs. Browser assertions require escaped plain-text cards, hidden narration, initially unselected choices, exact question identity and no proposal confirmation. Keyed semantic merge retains all six new assertion IDs and their consuming entities, all configure-work/answer-attention/view-live-work source/test rows, plugin guidance and generated bundles. Facet and producer-helper Go implementation bytes are unchanged by configuration communication integration; communication/runtime/UI/bundle sources match the target. Shared Session.Communication and settingsDiff participate in fixture projection/rule-confirmation flows; communication, facet and producer assertions cover those interactions. Existing75ms useful-success gates, default2,000, explicit overrides, rolling admission, Makebatch and cancellation behavior remain unchanged.
review.tests: Read TestRollbackRestoresGatewayProfileAndArchivesCurrent: compatible profile selection, one private0600 archive, old release selection and consumed-reference clearing are asserted. The existing installer and diagnostics suites remain required; no real-host operational acceptance is inferred. On the new target, inspected and ran TestSlowResponseRetainsAdmissionAndReturnsSuccess (125ms wait retains admission, then200/useful body), TestSlowRequestSignalsBeforeCompletionAndCorrelatesOutcome (pending/finished sanitized correlation), TestSlowRequestBodyStillCompletes and TestPerformanceGateFailsSlowSuccess (child returns useful200 but verification fails exceeded75ms). Provider/factory/httpbudget race compatibility suites passed. The transport fixture preparation change is verification-only: the large saved-source paging/search fixture now starts through the real HTTP pending response and waits for its exact projection key and current revision before the original functional call. Its original five-second call guard, all page/body/search/delivery assertions, and every separate 75ms successful-response gate remain intact. The blocked-producer regression rejects a different ready key and stale revision; a skip-producer mutation fails. Identical one-CPU/five-busy-process control fails the reviewed test at factory_test.go:236 and passes the repaired fixture with all assertions.
